Brand scorecard

All seven Generation Maine identities, graded on the same criteria: the two original v1 directions as first built on September 29, the revised v1 pair (after the Green Falls and Baxter Brewing changes), and the v2 marks. Scores are 1 to 10; the grade is the weighted average (A 8.5+, A- 8.0, B+ 7.5, B 7.0, B- 6.5, C+ 6.0, C 5.5, C- 5.0, D below). Sorted best first. Scores are a design judgment, not a survey.

  • Idea 15%Does the mark carry a story in one look?
  • Distinct 20%Clear of 76crew, Green Falls and Baxter Brewing
  • Small size 15%Reads as a 32 px avatar and 16 px favicon
  • Premium 15%Polish, restraint, craft
  • Fit 15%Transparent about Maine Policy; lets creators lead
  • Ease 10%A small team can repeat it in Canva and CapCut
  • System 10%Devices, motion and creator assets beyond the logo
v2 · Direction A

First Light

B+7.8 / 10
Recommended
Idea8
Distinct6
Small size9
Premium8
Fit8
Ease9
System8
  • One shape that reads at 16 px
  • Pink is unclaimed by any neighbor
  • Horizon rule and motion give it a system
  • Maine silhouette is also on Baxter cans and is common in general
  • Sun-in-a-disc still nods to Baxter's sun, even in pink

Path up: Redraw the outline by hand as a simplified, geometric Maine the brand owns, instead of map data. That lifts Distinct to 8 and the grade to A-.

Uses the First Light end card with this mark
Idea7
Distinct7
Small size8
Premium7

  • No state outline, so no Baxter overlap there
  • Geometric and easy to reproduce

Path up: Make the G unmistakably custom (a unique terminal or cut) so it cannot be mistaken for a generic G.

Idea8
Distinct5
Small size7
Premium6

Ease7

  • Best creator system: a stamp per town
  • ME reads as Maine and as first person
